name: Lore of Terra TD
detailed_description:
Lore of Terra – A Tower Defense Saga with Heart, Humor, and 80+ Characters

Boredom started it all.
The heroes of the South were tired—of meetings, of budgets, of routine. So they made a bad decision: invade the North. Now, eight vastly different continents clash in a tactical, story-rich tower defense game that’s as charming as it is strategic.

Welcome to Lore of Terra — where red snapper fish control fire, snowmen wear armor, and even the creeps aren’t really the bad guys.

Strategic Gameplay Meets Whimsical Storytelling

  • Explore nine continents with unique environments, characters, and challenges.

  • Defend your lands against adaptive enemies that evolve mid-game.

  • Discover over 80 original characters—each with their own backstory, quirks, and elemental traits.

  • Command unlikely heroes like Kuma, an anxious bear that harnesses electricity, or Pooka, a mischievous queen of the underworld.

Handcrafted by a Solo Dev and Friends

Created by a one-man studio with help from a passionate group of artists, composers, and storytellers, Lore of Terra was born out of the desire to make something truly different.

  • No ads.

  • No loot boxes.

  • No subscriptions.

  • Just a complete, premium experience with 40+ hours of gameplay.

A Universe Worth Exploring

As you play, you’ll unlock a full comic book storyline integrated into the game. The world of Lore of Terra is magical, diverse, and beautifully odd. You'll face armies of ice-covered porcupines, cactus boxers, and shadowy strategists—and maybe even design your own character as the game evolves.


Wishlist now and join the adventure to help bring this hand-crafted world to life.

short_description: Bad coffee. Boredom. And now—war. Southern forces have invaded the North in a dangerously curious conflict. Use your wits in Lore of Terra, a handcrafted tower defense game with charm, chaos, quirky characters, 9 continents, and 80+ unique allies and foes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics Card with Shader Model 3 support, 512
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound device

content_descriptors.notes: Lore of Terra TD features frequent fantasy combat involving battles between player-controlled defenses and waves of enemy creatures. The game includes stylized depictions of violence, such as explosions, magical attacks, and the defeat of humanoid and monster enemies. While not overly graphic, some scenes may include intense battle sequences.
